description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/goal-target-inference.ts the maximum number of inferred target shapes is hardcoded as the literal 3 inside .slice(0, 3) calls, which makes the bound unobservable and untunable at runtime. Add an optional field maxTargetShapes?: number to the InferGoalTargetShapesOpts interface, and at each .slice(0, 3) call site use opts.maxTargetShapes ?? 3 instead of the bare literal. This is a real behavioural change: callers can now raise or lower the target-shape bound, which they could not do before, and goal-host will supply it from the shaped walkBudget policy the way it already supplies other walk bounds via resolveWalkBudget. The default of 3 preserves current behaviour only when no caller overrides it. Nonce cap-policy-3f1d.
